title: 第9章 打人先打脸第10章 快速打击
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
遭到张三如此一顿臭骂，阿斯里等人脸色都铁青起来。
“你是要多管闲事吗？”
阿斯里将柔媚交给另外两人按住，自己则从床上爬下来，右手背上的魂印一闪，一把闪着寒光的长剑出现在阿斯里的右手中。
这长剑完全形态应该是一把三尺长剑，不过阿斯里现在也才六岁，他手中这把剑为契合其身形，再有魂力等级影响，剑身就一尺略长。
而且由于其魂力尚还低微，也没有魂环，所以这把长剑目前和普通的兵器并没有什么区别。
但是这也是一把实实在在的可以伤人的凶器，出现在脸上带血、面露凶芒的阿斯里手上，还是有一定威慑力的。
然而面对这实实在在的威胁，张三只是轻佻的挑眉，继续挑衅道：“你们在俺的雷区蹦迪，实在是胆大包天。反正这事我看不惯，我管定了！”
而柔媚这边见张三愿意帮自己当然是颇为欣喜和感动，但见张三这边势单力薄，与阿斯里等人对上怕讨不了好，就挣扎着喊道：
“你快走，叫人……唔！”
“安静点！”
押着柔媚的两个男孩中一个偏瘦的男孩，直接将柔媚的嘴给捂上了，而且这次由于前面柔媚咬伤过阿斯里，所以这位就聪明多了，手掌是直接捏住她的下巴不让她开口。
这样一来，柔媚就只能发出像是“呜呜”这样无意义的声音。
“呵，你小子可别不识抬举。”
而阿斯里这边见张三居然没半点害怕，不由得担心对方是不是真有什么有恃无恐的底牌，所以虽然他很生气，但还是没直接上去动手，只是继续威胁道：
“再不走，别怪我给你身上戳几个窟窿。”
这时张三语气突然软了不少，他说道：
“你的意思是，只要我走了你们就会放过我？”
“呵，如果你识趣的话……”
就在阿斯里以为张三其实已经认怂之时，张三突然阴阳怪气的说道：
“哎呀！你们的脾气真好，我脾气就没那么好了。”

“你们这帮人让我很生气，要让我消气的办法只有一个，那就是你们每个人都把手放头顶上，蹲地上像球一样滚出去。”
张三一边说着，一边视线向下微微一瞥，这个方向在旁人看来是什么都没有，而在张三眼中那边则是一个冒着蓝光的屏幕，按照系统的解释，这是系统的主页面板。
现在位于系统面板右下角，显示的“点数余额”一栏上的数字正在缓慢提升。
而这事还得从张三进门开始说起。
【本系统用于消耗的代币也就是“怨念点数”，主要来自于智慧生物，例如人类的负面情感，当适合的情感出现时，系统可以自动将其吸收。然而尽管负面情感在人类的情绪中一贯占有相当的比例，但并不是任何状态的人类都可以被系统吸收。】
其实这系统在张三进房间的一开始，就在其耳边喋喋不休的讲解起来了。
【一般情况下，如愤怒、怨恨等负面情感在人的情绪属于被压抑的隐性状态，这个状态系统无法将之吸收转化为可供您使用的点数，只有当人转换情感或情绪变为显性，导致该类负面情感逸散之后，系统才能将之吸收转化。】
“额？”
尽管系统说的很详细，但张三的内心依旧有些疑惑。
而且他还心道：这系统说的确实是人话，但自己咋听着就这么晕呢？
系统似乎是知道张三没听太懂，于是她干脆利落的说道：
【如果您对此还抱有疑问的话，现在您可以通过挑衅嘲讽的方式激起这些人类的愤怒，在被激怒后，他们的感情将会开始初步逸散，系统也将在同时为您吸收转化为点数。】
“哦？那我试试看。”
张三听之立刻开始了尝试，果然一番言语激将后，这四个面色铁青的男孩身上就开始冒出一团团橙红色的气团，这些气团在被自己周身一股无形的力量吸引过来之后就消失了。
不过这一幕似乎只有他自己能够看到，其他人都没有看到任何异常情况的样子。
而且这些橙红色气团似乎就代表着愤怒，只是这些气团在被吸收后，点数增加的相当有限。
自己这边把四个人指着鼻子大骂一顿也就加了不到五十的点数。
系统这时又提示道：
【若果想要更多点数的话，就请您尝试让这些人类出现更大的感情波动。】
“更大的情绪波动吗？”

张三一边喃喃自语一边注视着眼前这个提着长剑一脸戾气的男孩，不知为何他突然想起了那个手持修罗魔剑的身影，顿时浑身一颤。
“既然你找死！那我成全你。”
content_en:
After being scolded by Zhang San, Asri and others turned pale.
"Are you trying to meddle in other people's business?"
Asri handed Roumei to the other two people to hold her down, while he climbed down from the bed. The soul mark on the back of his right hand flashed, and a long sword with a cold light appeared in Asri's right hand.
The complete form of this long sword should be a three-foot long sword, but Asri is only six years old now. The sword in his hand fits his body shape, and due to the influence of his soul power level, the sword body is slightly longer than one foot.
And because its soul power is still low and there is no soul ring, this long sword is currently no different from an ordinary weapon.
But this is also a real weapon that can hurt people. It still has a certain deterrent effect when it appears in the hands of Asri, who has blood on his face and a fierce look on his face.
However, in the face of this real threat, Zhang San just raised his eyebrows frivolously and continued to challenge: "You are really audacious to dance in my minefield. Anyway, I can't stand this matter, I will take care of it!"
Of course Roumei was very happy and touched to see Zhang San willing to help her, but seeing that Zhang San was weak and afraid that she would not be able to gain favor from Asri and others, she struggled and shouted:
"Go quickly and call someone... ugh!"
"Quiet!"
One of the two boys who was holding Rou Mei was a thin one, and he directly covered Rou Mei's mouth. Moreover, this time because Rou Mei had bitten Asri before, this one was much smarter, and he directly pinched her chin with his palm to prevent her from speaking.
As a result, Roumei can only make meaningless sounds like "Woo".
"Oh, you kid doesn't know how to appreciate someone."
When Asri saw that Zhang San was not afraid at all, he couldn't help but worry about whether the other party really had any powerful trump cards. So although he was very angry, he still didn't go up to take action directly. He just continued to threaten:
"If you don't leave, don't blame me for poking a few holes in your body."
At this time, Zhang San's tone suddenly softened a lot, and he said:
"You mean you will let me go as long as I leave?"
"Ha, if you are sensible..."
Just when Asri thought that Zhang San had actually given up, Zhang San suddenly said in a sinister tone:
"Oh! You guys have such a good temper, but I don't have that good temper."
"You guys make me very angry, and there is only one way to calm me down, and that is for each of you to put your hands on top of your head, squat on the ground and roll out like a ball."
As Zhang San spoke, he glanced down slightly. To others, there was nothing in this direction, but in Zhang San's eyes, there was a screen with blue light. According to the system's explanation, this was the system's homepage panel.
Now located in the lower right corner of the system panel, the number on the displayed "Point Balance" column is slowly increasing.
And this matter has to start when Zhang San enters the door.
[The tokens used by this system are "resentment points", which mainly come from the negative emotions of intelligent creatures, such as humans. When suitable emotions appear, the system can automatically absorb them. However, although negative emotions always account for a considerable proportion of human emotions, not all humans in any state can be absorbed by the system. 】
In fact, this system was explained endlessly in Zhang San's ear from the very beginning when he entered the room.
[Under normal circumstances, negative emotions such as anger and resentment are suppressed and recessive in human emotions. This state system cannot absorb and convert them into points that can be used by you. Only when the person changes emotions or the emotions become explicit, causing such negative emotions to escape, can the system absorb and transform them. 】
"Uh?"
Although the system explained it in detail, Zhang San still had some doubts in his heart.
Moreover, he thought to himself: This system indeed speaks human language, but why does he feel so dizzy when he hears it?
The system seemed to know that Zhang San didn’t understand, so she simply saidLuode said:
[If you still have doubts about this, you can now arouse the anger of these humans through provocation and ridicule. After being angered, their emotions will begin to escape initially, and the system will absorb and convert them into points for you at the same time. 】
"Oh? Then I'll give it a try."
Zhang San immediately started trying after hearing this. Sure enough, after some words of encouragement, the four livid-faced boys began to have orange-red air masses coming out of their bodies. These air masses disappeared after being attracted by an invisible force around them.
However, it seemed that only he could see this scene, and no one else saw anything unusual.
Moreover, these orange-red air masses seem to represent anger, but after being absorbed, the points increase of these air masses is quite limited.
He pointed his nose at four people and cursed them, which only added less than fifty points.
The system then prompted again:
[If you want more points, please try to make these humans have greater emotional fluctuations. 】
"Bigger mood swings?"
Zhang San murmured to himself while looking at the boy in front of him who was holding a long sword with a stern expression. For some reason, he suddenly remembered the figure holding the Shura Demon Sword, and his whole body trembled.
"Since you are looking for death! Then I will help you."
